content: Multi-tap modifier detection: typical timeout window 200ms-1000ms (tools cluster ~300-500ms; Keyboard Maestro example 1.0s). Inherent tradeoff: detection latency >= timeout because system must wait to see if another tap comes; dual-function key literature confirms you cannot avoid the wait, only hide it. keyd issue 219: timeouts not natively supported in keyd. Karabiner/BetterTouchTool implement double-tap-shift hotkeys. SimpleSwitcher supports release triggers (fire on key release) and double-click detection. Design tension for goswitch: single Right Shift must switch layout <50ms but double right shift needs a wait window - needs explicit semantics (fire-on-release with short window, or fire immediately and undo on second tap).
